## Critique
- claim-1: Adequately grounded by [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 213-218].
- claim-2: Adequately grounded by [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 481-485]. Although the excerpt states only “ring involution,” integrality follows because \(\omega\) permutes the integral Schur basis, and grading preservation follows from \(|\lambda'|=|\lambda|\).
- claim-3: The basiswise proof is complete. Conjugation bijects partitions inside \(q^r\) with those inside \(r^q\), hence also bijects their complements; therefore \(\omega(I_{r,q})=I_{q,r}\). The induced quotient map is integral, weight-preserving, and has inverse \(\omega_{q,r}\). The explicit \(r=1\) and \(q=1\) checks cover both boundary cases. No finite \(G_L\)-to-\(G_R\) transition computation is used.

## Required revisions
- None. The requested claim-3 certificate is established exactly; no broader parent claim is asserted.
